about_the_game:
FLY GUYS is a 3D platformer open-world flying collectathon game. Play as a little owl guy named Fly Guy, or his partner in the sky, Fly Gal. Relax in this calming atmosphere surrounded by nature, and become a hero to all birds in The Archipelago! 

Fly around to discover new locations and explore the map, searching for eggs in an effort to rescue them all. Take on flight challenges that take you through tight turns, deep dives, and long distances.

FLY GUYS is a cozy adventure game that centers around collecting, exploration, fun flight, and memorable characters and moments.

Explore the many islands this world has to offer! From lush, green forests, to harsh, snow-covered tundras, FLY GUYS has a lot to love!

  • 🥚 Fully Open World - Fly to ANY island right at the beginning of the game. No loading!

  • 🪶 Collectables, Collectables! - With collectable feathers, wearable accessories, and rare fish to find, there's an abundance of fun things to be on the lookout for!

  • 🥚 Momentum-Based Flight - Master momentum-based flight in FLY GUYS—where speed, physics, airboosts, updrafts, and skill combine for exhilarating aerial freedom!

  • 🪶 Day-Night Cycle - Experience the beauty of The Archipelago at all times of day. Special events may be only at specific times of day!

  • 🥚 Exhilarating Flight-Based Challenges! - To get each egg back to their families, Fly Guy/Gal take on fast-paced, exciting flight based challenges! These can range from precision ring challenges, to popping bubbles!
